summary: Backend + Frontend testing of Velum PWA. 15/17 backend tests pass; discovered one CRITICAL bug: POST /api/actions cannot accept medication occurrence_keys because the key format med:{id}:{YYYY-MM-DD}:{HH:MM} splits into 5 parts via split(':') but server validates len(parts) != 4. Every attempt to mark a dose as Concluído/Não Concluído returns 400 'Ocorrência inválida', confirmed via API AND UI (toast error). Frontend UI itself (registration, login, logout, patient CRUD, medication CRUD, tabs, delay counter real-time rendering, mobile layout 390px) all work correctly. Appointments CRUD and appointment actions work (occurrence_key format appt:{id} has only 2 parts and goes through different branch).

critical.issue: occurrence_key 'med:{id}:{YYYY-MM-DD}:{HH:MM}' splits into 5 colon-separated parts; server at server.py:412-422 enforces len(parts)!=4 -> 400 'Ocorrência inválida'. Breaks ALL medication Concluído/Não Concluído actions, so Hoje page, patient agenda and history for medications are non-functional. Fix: parse by splitting into at most 4 segments (e.g., occurrence_key.split(':', 3)) or reconstruct hhmm from parts[3]+':'+parts[4] when len==5.

minor.issue: 5-fail lockout counter keyed by request.client.host; in the preview env the ingress occasionally rotates client IPs so lockout may not accumulate within 5-10 attempts. Marked xfail. Consider using X-Forwarded-For (leftmost) or user-agent for identifier when behind a trusted proxy.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking Concluído/Não Concluído on medication dose shows red toast 'Ocorrência inválida' (consequence of backend bug above). Status not persisted, no history entry.

integration_issues.issue: API 400 returned by /api/actions prevents moving item to 'Já registrados' and creating audit entry

action_items: FIX server.py mark_action occurrence_key parsing: replace parts = split(':') + len!=4 check with split(':',3) so that '{HH:MM}' remains in parts[3], or validate as regex. Example fix: parts = body.occurrence_key.split(':', 3); if len(parts) != 4 or parts[0] != 'med' or parts[1] != body.ref_id: 400. Then hhmm = parts[3] (already 'HH:MM').
After backend fix, re-run tests - the xfail in TestAgendaActions should become xpass; UI flow for Concluído should produce green toast + history entry.
Optional: harden login lockout against preview-env IP rotation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 412: `parts = body.occurrence_key.split(':')` without maxsplit is incompatible with the key format emitted by med_item() where hhmm contains ':'. Core logic broken.
notifier.py:14 GRACE=5min — if the notifier loop misses a dose by >5 min (service restart, long GC), the user never gets a push. Consider wider grace or last-sent cursor.
server.py seeded admin uses role 'admin' but all endpoints treat caregivers uniformly; isolation uses owner_id which is correct, so admin has no elevated access — document or remove the field.
server.py set_access_cookie uses secure=True unconditionally — fine for prod HTTPS preview, but will break local http dev.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all UI flows work except marking Concluído which fails due to backend bug)

The TestAgendaActions test is marked xfail — after the occurrence_key parsing fix, flip the expected assertion back. rca of the issue: RCA: In server.py mark_action the server attempts to decompose the medication occurrence_key with `parts = body.occurrence_key.split(':')` and then enforces `len(parts) != 4`. The medication occurrence_key emitted by med_item() is `f'med:{med.id}:{local_date.isoformat()}:{hhmm}'` where hhmm is a `HH:MM` string containing a colon. The resulting list has 5 elements (['med', id, 'YYYY-MM-DD', 'HH', 'MM']) so the length check always fails -> HTTPException 400 'Ocorrência inválida'. Reproduction: register, create patient, create medication, call POST /api/actions with the exact occurrence_key returned by GET /api/agenda/today → 400. Mitigation: `parts = body.occurrence_key.split(':', 3)` (maxsplit=3) keeps 'HH:MM' intact as parts[3]; also drop the brittle `len(parts[3]) == 5` ternary and simply use `hhmm = parts[3]`.
